svg.title: EncodeIt watch-folder integrations (dark)

g.aria-label: Wait for file size to settle.
Keep EncodeIt running. Only new arrivals after a watch is enabled are queued.
This does not replace the host application's codecs or Deliver interface.

svg.desc: After Effects, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve export files into watched folders. EncodeIt waits for writes to settle, then encodes to output. It does not replace host codecs.
